boundedTeamRowAuthorization.temperatureReason: Team member list and membership request authorization.
boundedTeamRowAuthorization.reason: Mechanical reuse of the existing team-member owner (BeginTeamMemberRequestRead) with literal installed team-ID resolution (ResolveTeamID) and the shared ErrResourceAccessChanged retry with API-key reauthentication; a team row may stay visible to an admin who cannot read that private team's content. Every caller path is certified on this branch: the team member routes (TestScaleP21SW315TeamMembershipAuthorization, escaped TestScaleP21SW330EscapedTeamAuthorizationDifferential), the workspace team membership route (TestScaleP21SW306MembershipAuthorization, escaped TestScaleP21SW332EscapedMembershipAuthorization with id, alias, private, missing and empty refs), the escaped team resource row (TestScaleP21SW307TeamResourceRouteDifferential and its cancellation/boundary test) and the fallback team-row shape for /api/teams/{id}/... and /api/workspaces/{key}/teams/{teamId}/... (TestScaleP21SW491FallbackAuthorizationDifferential, warm and SQL-reloaded, with key and lowercase-alias refs, retired, child, private and missing teams and a foreign path), all legacy-equal with zero full decodes.
